description: A contract that passes `demo.shared/1`'s envelopes about, so that two expansions of it can be put on opposite ends of one connection.

One unary op and one stream op, both naming an imported shape in every position the generator has to resolve: an argument, a result, and a stream item. A call site may map the vocabulary to a module or ask for copies with `inline`, and the point of the test that uses this file is that the two are indistinguishable on the wire.

The shape this contract passes about. `Kind` and `Body` are reached through it and deliberately not listed here: an import names the shapes this contract's own wire mentions, not everything they hold.

types.name: RelayResult
description: What the producer made of it.

fields.name: envelope
description: The envelope as the producer saw it, sent straight back.

fields.name: seen
description: How many envelopes this producer has relayed, including this one.

types.name: EchoArgs
description: What an echo stream is asked for.

fields.name: count
description: How many copies of it to put on the stream.

errors.name: refused
description: The producer would not relay this envelope.

ops.name: demo.relay.relay
description: Relay one envelope and answer with it. An imported shape in both the argument and the result.

ops.name: demo.relay.echo
description: Put the envelope on a stream the asked-for number of times. An imported shape as a stream item, which is the third position the generator resolves.
